caption: These oat flour + Greek yogurt pancakes are officially on repeat in our house. 🥞✨ I love having a few go-to toddler breakfasts that are both simple and nutritious, and this recipe checks all the boxes. Made with wholesome ingredients, packed with protein from the Greek yogurt, and naturally kid-approved. ✨ Ingredients: • 1 ripe banana • 1 egg • 4 tbsp oat flour • 1/4 tsp baking powder • 2 tbsp Greek yogurt • Handful of blueberries ✨ Directions: Mash the banana, then mix in the egg, oat flour, baking powder, and Greek yogurt. Fold in the blueberries. Cook on a lightly greased pan over low-medium heat until golden brown on both sides. Makes about 4 pancakes. #ToddlerMeals #easyrecipe #toddlerbreakfast #babyledweaning #toddlerrecipes
